blurb: Hookedup Charters offers full-time fishing charters on Lake Ontario based out of Rochester, NY. Guests fish for trophy salmon, trout, and smallmouth bass. The home port is on the Genesee River, providing multiple fishing options regardless of lake conditions.

quotes.text: Captain Bruce exceeded my expectations!!! I was beyond impressed by some of the fish he helped us catch. I went out there expecting to catch a 6lb fish at most, but ended up catching two 20lb king salmon along with some other 10lb+ trout. He was extremely nice and helpful, and taught us a lot about fishing in lake and how to catch certain fish. He taught us how to succeed in reeling in heavy fish and introduced us to different lures. If i had to rate my experience from 1-10, i’d give him a 20! It was definitely worth waking up at 4:00am

I booked a trip with Bruce for my dad, husband, nephew, and good friend for Father’s Day. It far exceeded their expectations! They came home with a ton of fish and a ton of laughs and stories recapping their day. They could not have been more complimentary of Bruce, which is quite a feat given he was catering to ages 25 to 77. They loved the day so much, they are booking a trip for September, with Bruce of course! Thank you Bruce for giving the most important men in my life the best Father’s Day Ever!

Captain Bruce was an awesome host with a great amount of knowledge of the fisheries and the region in general. He was very conversational and friendly, and even better, he got us on the fish. We had a full day trip, but ended up catchin our limits by 1pm with a mixed bag of King Salmon, Steelhead, and Brown trout, with many very big fish by our standards. We had a great time and booked to come back the following year before we even got off the boat. 10/10 would recommend Captain Bruce.

This was our 4th charter with Captain Bruce, and definitely not the last. The fish seemed to be scattered but Bruce was still knowledgeable to get us on quite a few. We are definitely coming back ,made the decision while we were still on the boat. If anyone wants a charter with the hardest working captain I have ever fished with, Captain Bruce is the one. Thank You Bruce for another great trip, looking forward to seeing you for some Brown Trout action in April.

What a fantastic experience. Captain Bruce and his crew are total pros. The Boat was comfortable and spacious. I wasn’t expecting to catch so many fish let alone huge fish!!!! King Salmon and Steelhead. Captain Bruce fileted them beautifully so now we can share a feast with our friends. Captain and crew were so knowledgeable. I learned alot as well as laughed and had a great time. I will most definitely do it again. Thank you Captain Bruce for a great day.

Another excellent trip with Captain Bruce. It was tough fishing but the captain did a fantastic job at getting the fish to grab the hook. Us on the other hand need some work keeping them on. None the less, we had a great time and we already booked for next year. Good luck to all that go out with Hooked Up, just save some for our next trip. Thank you very much Captain Bruce, we’ll see you next year.
